name: melonDS (Android) / MelonDualDS

launch.notes: ES-DE: %EMULATOR_MELONDS% %ACTION%=me.magnum.melonds.LAUNCH_ROM %EXTRA_uri%=%ROMSAF%. Upstream manifest declares the action as ${applicationId}.LAUNCH_ROM and EmulatorActivity reads extra KEY_URI = 'uri' (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rafaelvcaetano/melonDS-android/master/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml, https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rafaelvcaetano/melonDS-android/master/app/src/main/java/me/magnum/melonds/ui/emulator/EmulatorActivity.kt). For the MelonDualDS package try '<package>.LAUNCH_ROM' first, then 'me.magnum.melonds.LAUNCH_ROM' (ES-DE uses the latter for both).

configTarget.notes: Reference only: melonDS Android stores settings in Android SharedPreferences (preference XML keys such as video_renderer, video_internal_resolution), which other apps cannot write.

values.reason: The software renderer is the default and does not upscale; valid values software/opengl/compute from arrays.xml.
Largest integer scale of 192-line screens that fits the Thor's 1080-line top panel; allowed values 1-8 in arrays.xml.

manualNotes: Thor guides recommend the MelonDualDS build, which puts the DS bottom screen on the Thor's bottom display (Retro Handhelds Thor guide, search snippet only).
melonDS works with FreeBIOS but accepts real BIOS/firmware dumps (https://github.com/Desage56/ayn-thor-claude-skill/blob/main/thor-handheld/references/emulators.md).
